1077.title: [TASK] #1076 — Wire drop_chance as outer gate for item + gold loot drops
1077.body:
## Task

`drop_chance` column on `game_config_enemies` was stored but never applied to actual loot rolling. All enemies dropped items and gold at identical rates regardless of their configured chance.

Implementation commit: 515bdc3a

## What was implemented

### Three functions in `loot_service.py` now apply `drop_chance` as an outer gate:

| Function | Change |
|----------|--------|
| `roll_loot()` | Reads `drop_chance` alongside `loot_table_key`; `random.random() > dc → return []` |
| `roll_gold_drop()` | Reads `e.drop_chance` in JOIN query; `random.random() > dc → return 0` |
| `roll_loot_for_class()` (MP) | Same gate per player — independent roll per party member |

### Effective behavior with current enemy values:

| Enemy | drop_chance | Old | New |
|-------|------------|-----|-----|
| slime | 0.3 | Always rolled | 30% of kills yield loot |
| ghost | 0.5 | Always rolled | 50% chance |
| goblin | 0.7 | Always rolled | 70% chance |
| orc | 0.9 | Always rolled | 90% chance |
| boss | 1.0 | Always rolled | Always drops (no change) |

### Gate semantics

`drop_chance` is a **single roll** covering both items AND gold — same dice, same kill. If it fails, the enemy drops nothing. If it passes, per-entry weights (`game_config_loot_entries.weight`) still determine which specific items drop.

## Files changed

- `backend/app/services/loot_service.py` — `roll_loot`, `roll_gold_drop`, `roll_loot_for_class` each gain a drop_chance read + gate
- `backend/tests/test_issue568_loot_rng_not_bug.py` — 2 new gate tests (`drop_chance=0.0` always blocks, `drop_chance=1.0` always passes); updated fake conn to return `drop_chance` field
- `backend/tests/test_phase8c_loot_service.py` — updated `side_effect` list to include the extra `random.random()` call consumed by the gate

## Backend

No new endpoints or migrations. Pure logic change in `loot_service.py`.

## Numbers Policy

All `drop_chance` values are starting values tunable per enemy in the admin panel. Current values set when enemies were created; this PR makes them functional for the first time.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Kill a `slime` (drop_chance=0.3) multiple times — loot appears ~30% of kills (no gold/items on ~70%)
- [ ] Kill a `goblin` (drop_chance=0.7) — loot appears ~70% of kills
- [ ] Kill a boss (drop_chance=1.0) — always drops
- [ ] Admin panel: verify drop_chance visible on enemy config, can be edited
- [ ] `pytest tests/test_issue568_loot_rng_not_bug.py` — 5 passed

## Out of scope

- Separate `drop_chance` per gold vs items (current: one gate for both)
- UI display of enemy drop_chance to player
